chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: All three energy plus the free card, entirely into damage. Gorou costs 0 for 6 (it exhausts, so there is no reason to hold it). All Streams Flow to the Sea for 1: printed 9, plus Charge at one point per two Charge, so 8 Charge gives +4, for 13. Then two Water's Edge at 1 each for 6 apiece. Total 31 into a 38 HP Sludge Spinner, leaving it on 7. I take the telegraphed 8 to the face and end the turn at 40/70 with no Block. Seven HP is inside the reach of essentially any single card I can draw, so the kill is locked for next turn barring a summon or a heal I have no reason to expect.
q2_other_line_considered: Yes, a defensive split: Gorou (0) for 6, All Streams (1) for 13, one Water's Edge (1) for 6, one Coral Guard (1) for 5 Block — 25 damage, take 3 instead of 8, enemy left on 13. I rejected it because 13 remaining is not a guaranteed one-turn close: with 3 energy and All Streams spent, only Itto - Superlative Guard actually gets there alone (14), and if I don't draw it I need two turns and eat another 8, which is strictly worse than the 5 HP I saved. I also priced Itto - Superlative Guard as the whole turn (3 energy, 14 damage, 6 Block) plus free Gorou: 20 damage and 6 Block. It loses 11 damage to buy 6 Block, which is a bad rate here. Bake-Kurage was checked and discarded on arithmetic: it costs 1 and its +1 Charge takes me from 8 to 9, which still reads as +4 on All Streams, so I would pay a full energy for nothing this turn.
q3_what_it_gave_up: Five points of health this turn (8 taken instead of 3), both Coral Guards left unplayed, and Itto - Superlative Guard held. I gave up the safe, low-variance version of the turn in exchange for putting the enemy in one-card kill range. I also spent Gorou permanently — it exhausts — on a fight I could have closed without it, and I applied Hydro three times with nothing on the board to react with, so that rider was pure text.
q4_different_intent: Yes. Against a telegraphed hit around 16 or more, or any multi-hit that a 5 Block card cannot meaningfully blunt, I would have played Itto - Superlative Guard plus Gorou for 20 damage and 6 Block, or the Gorou / All Streams / double Coral Guard line for 19 damage and 10 Block, and accepted a slower kill. At 48/70 an 8-damage telegraph is cheap enough that racing is correct; roughly double that and the arithmetic flips to blocking. A defensive or buffing intent would have pushed me even harder toward the pure-damage line I already chose.
